test_title: PYST 21: SSC CHSL 2024 - Quantitative Aptitude (Held On: 08 Jul, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: maths
question: Antony and Julie can simultaneously complete a work of floor decoration in 15 days and Julie alone in 20 days. In how many days can Antony alone complete the work of floor decoration?
solution:
**Given:**

Antony and Julie together can complete the work in 15 days

Julie alone can complete the work in 20 days

**Formula used:**

Work rate of Antony and Julie together = Work rate of Antony + Work rate of Julie

Work rate = 1 / Time taken to complete the work

**Calculation:**

Work rate of Antony and Julie together = 1/15

Work rate of Julie alone = 1/20

⇒ 1/15 = Work rate of Antony + 1/20

⇒ Work rate of Antony = 1/15 - 1/20

⇒ Work rate of Antony = (4 - 3) / 60

⇒ Work rate of Antony = 1/60

⇒ Time taken by Antony alone = 1 / (Work rate of Antony)

⇒ Time taken by Antony alone = 60 days

**∴ The correct answer is option 1.**
